search.description: Find public products by text and filters. Empty q browses. Prices are EUR cents: maxPriceMinor=2500 means €25. Use productId from returned items for recommendations. Defaults include active out-of-stock offers. Returns items, total and pagination.

q.description: Trimmed; at most 200 characters and 20 terms. Empty allows browsing. Default: empty.

availability.description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.

minPriceMinor.description: Inclusive minimum, nonnegative safe integer in euro cents.

maxPriceMinor.description: Inclusive maximum; must be at least minPriceMinor.

sort.description: relevance, price_asc, price_desc, or name_asc. Default: relevance.

page.description: Positive safe integer. Pages beyond the end return empty items. Default: 1.

facets.description: Discover filter values and counts for a search. Each facet ignores its own filter; price range ignores both price bounds. Prices are EUR cents. Returns categories, sellers, availability counts and a nullable price range.

q.description: Trimmed; at most 200 characters and 20 terms. Empty allows browsing. Default: empty.

availability.description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.

minPriceMinor.description: Inclusive minimum, nonnegative safe integer in euro cents.

maxPriceMinor.description: Inclusive maximum; must be at least minPriceMinor.

autocomplete.description: Suggest product names from a normalized full-name prefix, e.g. q="wire". Requires at least two characters. Returns suggestions with productId and name, or an empty list.

q.description: At least 2 characters; at most 200 characters and 20 terms. Normalized name prefix.

availability.description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.

similar.description: Find alternatives to an active product, e.g. productId="prd_1" from search. Ranks same-category products by shared attributes and price difference, excluding the source. Missing or hidden source returns 404. Returns items, possibly empty. Not purchase evidence.

availability.description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.

also_bought.description: Find products occurring with productId (e.g. "prd_1") in synthetic purchase groups. Returns items ranked by co-occurrence, excluding the source. Missing/hidden source returns 404. No evidence means empty items: do not substitute similarity or claim real customer behavior.

availability.description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.
